mapper.select:
SELECT FROM ai_capability WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND del_flag = 0
AND (capability_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR capability_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR source_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND publish_status = #{publishStatus}
ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM ai_capability WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM ai_capability WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND capability_code = #{capabilityCode} AND del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM ai_capability WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND protocol_tool_name = #{toolName} AND del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.capability_code, c.capability_name, c.current_version, c.source_type, c.behavior, c.risk_level, c.required_actor_type, c.publish_status, c.enabled, v.input_schema, v.policy_snapshot FROM ai_capability c LEFT JOIN ai_capability_version v ON v.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND v.capability_id = c.id AND v.version = c.current_version AND v.del_flag = 0 WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.enabled = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, c.capability_name ASC, c.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_capability SET enabled = 0, publish_status = 'DISABLED', del_flag = id, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0
